adjudication.rationale: In `packages/app-store/googlecalendar/lib/CalendarService.ts`, `deleteEvent` now computes `calendarId` as `externalCalendarId ? externalCalendarId : event.destinationCalendar?.find((cal) => cal.externalId === externalCalendarId)?.externalId;`. Because the `.find(...)` branch only runs when `externalCalendarId` is falsy (e.g., `undefined`/`null`), it compares `cal.externalId === externalCalendarId` where `externalCalendarId` is falsy, so it will not match any real calendar externalId and yields `undefined`. This effectively causes deletion to target the default calendar ("primary" / default fallback), breaking deletion of events that live on a non-primary destination calendar when `externalCalendarId` isn’t provided.
